canonical_title: Scale AI appoints Francis deSouza as CEO
treatment: Treat as a Scale AI leadership and strategy transition. Reinclude only for concrete restructuring, major customer or partner changes, material changes to the data/evaluation business, applications revenue overtaking data, acquisition or financing events, or a reversal of the enterprise and government applications strategy.
known_facts: Scale AI appointed Google Cloud COO Francis deSouza as CEO effective August 10, 2026.
He replaces interim CEO Jason Droege, who had led Scale since founder Alexandr Wang departed for Meta in 2025.
Scale said it is expanding both its data and applications businesses.
Axios reported that Scale expects its applications business to overtake its data business within 18 months.
The appointment signals a strategic shift from primarily supplying training data and human evaluation toward enterprise and government AI deployment systems.
reinclude_only_if: Scale AI announces a material restructuring, workforce change, acquisition, financing event, or major customer loss or win under Francis deSouza.
Scale discloses that its applications business has overtaken its data business or materially revises that target.
The CEO transition date, role, or strategy is materially changed.
Scale changes its relationship with Meta or other frontier-model customers in a way that affects its data or evaluation business.
notes: Selected for the 2026-07-31 Midday Brief. This is a corporate-strategy topic, not a model release. The strongest delta is the explicit move toward enterprise and government AI applications, with the applications business expected to surpass the original data business.
